import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod;

    static int add(int x, int y) {
        x += y;
        return x >= mod ? x - mod : x;
    }

    static int mul(int x, int y) {
        return (int)((long)x * y % mod);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();
        final int maxn = 505;
        int[][] C = new int[maxn][maxn];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = add(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        int[] f = new int[maxn];
        int[] g = new int[maxn];
        f[0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                f[i] = add(f[i], mul(mul(f[j - 1], f[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1])));
                g[i] = add(g[i], mul(mul(f[j - 1], g[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1])));
                g[i] = add(g[i], mul(mul(g[j - 1], f[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1])));
                g[i] = add(g[i], mul(mul(f[j - 1], f[i - j]), mul(add(C[j][2], C[i - j + 1][2]), C[i - 1][j - 1])));
            }
        }

        int[][] F = new int[maxn][maxn];
        int[][] G = new int[maxn][maxn];
        F[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            F[i][i] = f[i];
            G[i][i] = g[i];
            for (int j = 0; j <= Math.min(i - 1, m); j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l <= j; l++) {
                    F[i][j] = add(F[i][j], mul(mul(f[l], F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]));
                    G[i][j] = add(G[i][j], mul(mul(g[l], F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]));
                    G[i][j] = add(G[i][j], mul(mul(f[l], G[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]));
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(G[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
